intro: Sayings that Spanish speakers quote all the time, often only the first half.
p.refrán.consejo: It is a short, old sentence that gives advice. You say «como dice el refrán…».
p.madrugar.consejo: It comes from «madrugada». It is regular, like «hablar». The g is hard: «ma-dru-GAR».
p.palo.consejo: In the proverb, the stick is the father and the splinter is the child.
p.astilla.consejo: It is written with ll and sounds «as-TI-ya»: the ll sounds like y.
p.mosca.consejo: It is feminine: «la mosca». In the proverb, flies get into an open mouth.
p.pájaro.consejo: It is proparoxytone: it has a tilde on the first a. The j sounds like a strong h.
p.caballo.consejo: The ll sounds like y. It is used in «a caballo regalado no le mires el diente».
p.diente.consejo: It is masculine: «el diente». It has a diphthong: «DYEN-te», one syllable for «ie».
p.abarcar.consejo: It is written with c before a, but «abarque» with qu. «Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta».
p.apretar.consejo: It changes e to ie: «aprieto», «aprietas», «aprieta», but «apretamos».
p.regalado.consejo: It comes from «regalar». Here it is a participle working as an adjective: «caballo regalado».
b1.texto:
A **refrán** packs advice into one sentence. People often say only the beginning and let the other person finish it: «Ya sabes, no por mucho madrugar…»

Their grammar is old and compact, and you now have the tools to read it.

- **No hay mal que por bien no venga**: a relative clause in the subjunctive after «no hay».
- **No por mucho madrugar amanece más temprano**: «por mucho» + infinitive means «however much you do it».
- **De tal palo, tal astilla**: there is no verb at all. From such a stick, such a splinter.
- **A caballo regalado no le mires el diente**: a negative command.
- **Más vale** X **que** Y: X is worth more than Y.
- **Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta**: whoever takes on a lot, holds little tight.
b2.f0.texto: I missed the train, but at the station I found an old friend.
b2.f1.texto: Every cloud has a silver lining.
b2.f2.texto: My brother talks non-stop, just like my father.
b2.f4.texto: Did you make it to the meeting on time?
b2.f7.texto: Rushing does not make the day dawn any sooner.
b4.texto:
Proverbs use compact forms.

- **No verb**: **De tal palo, tal astilla**. The verb is understood: «de tal palo sale tal astilla».
- **Command order**: **A caballo regalado no le mires el diente**. It speaks to anyone.
- **Comparison with «más vale»**: **Más vale** pájaro en mano **que** ciento volando.
- **Subject with «quien»**: **Quien** mucho abarca, poco aprieta. «Quien» equals «la persona que».
- **Negative sentence with subjunctive**: **No hay mal que** por bien no **venga**.

To use them well, quote them whole or start one and let the other person finish.
b4.e0.texto: Flies do not enter a closed mouth.
b4.e1.texto: Whoever takes on a lot holds little.
b4.e2.texto: Do not look a gift horse in the mouth.
b5.f0.texto: At dawn, the village market wakes up among coloured awnings.
b5.f1.texto: The fruit stalls smell of quince and wet earth.
b5.f2.texto: A grandfather with big hands arranges the crates patiently.
b5.f3.texto: His deep voice repeats old proverbs to every customer.
b5.f4.texto: The children listen to him with open mouths and shining eyes.
b5.f5.texto: A sparrow lands on the edge of a crate of pears.
b5.f6.texto: The grandfather smiles and says that a bird in the hand is worth more.
b5.f7.texto: A girl looks at the grapes with greedy eyes.
b5.f8.texto: The sun rises slowly and warms the blue canvas.
b5.f9.texto: At the end of the morning, the market keeps its voices in silence.
b6.o0: No hay mal que por bien no venga
b6.o0.refuerzo: That is it: something good came out of the bad.
b6.o1: En boca cerrada no entran moscas
b6.o2.refuerzo: That warns against taking on too much.
b6.pregunta: Your friend lost his job and found a better one. Which proverb fits?
b6.titulo: A bad thing with a happy end
b7.frase: No por mucho ____ amanece más temprano.
b7.o0.refuerzo: After «por mucho» comes an infinitive, not a conjugated verb.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Well done: «madrugar» is the infinitive in the proverb.
b7.o2.refuerzo: After «por mucho» comes an infinitive, not a participle.
b8.o1: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
b8.o2.refuerzo: That is it: the splinter is like the stick.
b8.pregunta: A girl is just like her mother. Which proverb fits?
b10.o1.refuerzo: That is it: one bird in the hand beats a hundred flying.
b10.o2.refuerzo: That idea belongs to «no por mucho madrugar…».
b10.pregunta: «Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando» advises you to…
b11.pregunta: Complete the proverb: «Más vale tarde que…»
b12.o0: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
b12.o0.refuerzo: That is it: do not inspect a gift.
b12.o2: No hay mal que por bien no venga
b12.o2.refuerzo: That is about the good after the bad.
b12.pregunta: You get a gift you dislike. Which proverb says not to complain?
b12.titulo: A gift you do not like
p.llegaste.consejo: From «llegar», to arrive. The «-aste» ending is the past tense for «tú».
p.boca.consejo: In the saying it means a closed mouth. The «c» before «a» is always a hard «k».
p.entran.consejo: From «entrar», to go in. The «-an» ending is for «ellos» or «ellas».
p.moscas.consejo: Plural of «mosca». In the proverb it means small annoyances that can get in.
p.abarca.consejo: From «abarcar», to cover or take on a lot. The stress falls on «AR».
p.mires.consejo: From «mirar», to look. The form «mires» is in the subjunctive, after «no».
p.toldos.consejo: Plural of «toldo», the cloth cover that shades a shop. Often bright and colourful in markets.
p.huelen.consejo: From «oler», to smell. The «h» is silent and «ue» is read as one sound, «we».
p.membrillo.consejo: A yellow fruit used to make a sweet jelly. The «ll» is pronounced like «y» in most of Spain.
p.refranes.consejo: Plural of «refrán», a popular saying. The stress falls on «FRA».
p.viejos.consejo: The «v» sounds like «b» and the «j» like «h»: «BYE-hos». It agrees with the plural «refranes».
p.gorrión.consejo: A small brown bird. The stress falls on the last syllable, and the «r» is strong.
p.posa.consejo: From «posar», to rest or perch. Birds «se posan» on a branch or a crate.
p.peras.consejo: Plural of «pera». The «r» between vowels is a single soft tap.
p.golosos.consejo: From «goloso», fond of sweets. Here it describes eyes that want the grapes.
p.lonas.consejo: Plural of «lona», a heavy cloth. The «n» at the end does not change the stress.
